why./auth/callback: OAuth redirect target. The provider navigates here; there is no click path and there should not be one.
why./payment/success: Stripe return URL. Reached by redirect after checkout.
why./payment/cancel: Stripe return URL. Reached by redirect after an abandoned checkout.
why./documents/[id]: Detail route behind a PLACEHOLDER list: src/app/documents/page.tsx renders [1,2,3,4].map(...) rather than real documents, so it has no ids to link. Linking it from a placeholder would fabricate navigation to records that do not exist. Unblocked by wiring the list to real data, not by adding a nav entry.
why./financial/coach/goal-detail/[id]: Same shape: src/app/financial/coach/goals/page.tsx renders a placeholder array and links only back to /financial/coach.
why./investments/crypto/[coinId]: There is no /investments/crypto list page at all — the directory contains only [coinId]. Needs a list before a detail can be reached.

note: 6 of 204. Three are redirect targets that are correctly unclickable; three are detail routes whose list pages are placeholders. None is a navigation gap — every real feature area is now in the sidebar.
